name: sparkrun
description: Launch, manage, and stop recipe-based inference workloads on single-node or multi-node DGX Spark setups.
compatibility: vLLM, SGLang, and llama.cpp recipes; SSH-based node management and InfiniBand/RDMA tensor parallelism.
Bundled LiteLLM proxy gateway by default across stable, beta, and alpha channels; optional external plugin integrations such as SparkRoute and ColdSnap.
limitations: Guided setup configures SSH mesh, ConnectX-7 NICs, sudoers, and earlyoom, and sparkrun update refreshes managed plugins and recipe registries unless --no-update-plugins is passed; review recipes and permissions before running.
Anonymous usage telemetry to telemetry.sparkrun.dev is enabled by default; disable persistently with sparkrun setup telemetry --disable or for one process with SPARKRUN_NO_TELEMETRY=1.
SparkRoute and ColdSnap are not bundled and are installed separately as external plugins with their own upstream repositories and licenses; OCI Relay remains bundled.

sources.note: Documents multi-runtime DGX Spark recipes, guided setup permissions, update channels, and anonymous telemetry defaults and opt-out.
Confirms LiteLLM is the default proxy gateway and SparkRoute and ColdSnap are separately installed external plugins rather than bundled components.
